title: Quadratic Reduction and Classical Multiple-Index Fibonacci-Lucas Identities
summary: We place several classical identities in a common algebraic framework. Let $x$ be an element of a unital algebra over a commutative ring $R$ satisfying $$ x^2-tx+d1=0. $$ Then every positive power of $x$ admits the universal reduction $$ x^m=P_m(t,d)x-dP_{m-1}(t,d)1, $$ where the coefficient polynomials $P_m$ form the generic Lucas sequence and are equivalently Dickson polynomials of the second kind.
